io

Interface ExcelWritable

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.lang.AutoCloseable, Writable
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractWorkbook, AppendWorkbook, WriteWorkbook, WriteWorkbookStreaming

    public interface ExcelWritable
extends Writable
    Defines an extended writing contract for spreadsheet formats that support multiple worksheets and worksheet formatting.

    In addition to the operations defined by Writable, implementations provide functionality for creating worksheets, configuring automatic filters, applying alternating row styles, and accessing the alternating row style factory.

    Since:
    7 October 2026

    Author:
